description.narrative: The project is implemented in Palestine. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights, and promoting peace and dialogue. The main rights holders are young Palestinians. Through capacitating young people to advocate and campaign for legislative and policy changes as well as practicing good governance locally, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between PYALARA and The Palme Center. PYALARA is a youth organisation that works to advance the position of young palestinans through advocacy and campaign as well as capacitating young Palestinians in various social and political fields, inspiring them to civic engagement. They have been running a campaign to lower the electoral age in Palestinian elected bodies.Other Donors to the OrganisationPYALARAs donors include French Consulate, AMAN, Bread for the World, GIZ, OXFAM, UNESCO, DW and EU. Possibilities to coordinate with other donors will explored.Project ObjectivePYALARA will work to make young Palestinians serve as human rights advocates to advance social cohesion and equality and social justice, partly through involving young Palestinians with decision makers and the Palestinian public.Actor groupsDecision Makers: politicians, heads of local councils, mayors, legislators, heads of CSOs. Also international decision makers. Actors in Cooperation: Young Palestinians cooperating with local decision makers and parts of civil society. Rights holders: young Palestinians, both male and female.
